title: North Korea opens landmark coastal Wonsan tourist zone, Russian envoy attends the ceremony
summary: North Korea has completed the construction of the Wonsan Kalma coastal tourist zone on its east coast, a significant project led by Kim Jong Un to boost tourism. Kim attended the inaugural ceremony with "great satisfaction" and announced plans to build more large-scale tourist zones. The development of Wonsan, a popular vacation spot for locals, has been underway since 2014 to transform it into a major tourist destination.

title: Chinese maglev vehicle hits 650 km/h on test track
summary: Researchers from Donghu Laboratory in Hubei Province, China, have accelerated a 1.1-ton maglev vehicle to 650 km/h in seven seconds, setting a new world record for the fastest maglev train. The vehicle operates using electromagnetic repulsion, with no physical contact with the track, and is only constrained by air resistance during acceleration. The researchers aim to reach a speed of 800 km/h by the end of the year.

title: Will Xi, Putin and Trump watch China's Sept. 3 military parade? Is China planning to invite POTUS?
summary: China, the U.S., and Russia are reportedly planning to jointly commemorate the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People’s War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-fascist War, as well as the founding of the United Nations. There is speculation about whether Xi, Putin, and Trump will attend China's military parade on September 3 and if China plans to invite the U.S. President. Mao Ning from the State Council Information Office mentioned that arrangements for inviting foreign leaders to the events have been shared, but no specific information is available at the moment.

title: Teary-eyed Kim seen watching himself draping coffin with N.Korean flag at gala marking Russia ties
summary: North Korea's state media showed leader Kim Jong Un draping coffins with the national flag, likely in the repatriation of soldiers killed fighting for Russia against Ukraine, as the countries marked a military treaty signed last year. At a gala in Pyongyang, Kim was seen covering coffins with flags and pausing with his hands on them, following images of North Korean and Russian soldiers waving their national flags. Kim appeared emotional, and audience members were seen wiping away tears.

title: China PLA's aircraft carrier Shandong leads Naval fleet to Hong Kong for historic visit
summary: China's first domestically built aircraft carrier, Shandong, will lead a naval fleet to Hong Kong from July 3-7 to mark the 28th anniversary of the city's return to China. The fleet includes Yan'an and Zhanjiang missile destroyers and Yuncheng frigate, offering public tours with 10,000 tickets available. This is the PLA Navy's first carrier group visit to Hong Kong in eight years, following Shandong's joint exercises with carrier Liaoning beyond the "Second Island Chain." The Shandong, commissioned in 2019, highlights China's naval modernization.
